```{r}
amedt <- read.csv(file='../data/amedt_all.csv')

qualtrics <- read.csv(file='../data/qualtrics/qualtrics_surveyscores.csv')

qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"-")
qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"-")
#qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"\+1")
qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"\\(")
qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"\\)")
qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID,"\\+1 ")
qualtrics$PUBLICID <- stringr::str_remove(qualtrics$PUBLICID," ")

qualtrics_amedt <- amedt %>%
  select(c("session.p_id", "EDT.ability")) %>%
  merge(qualtrics, by.y="PUBLICID", by.x="session.p_id", all.y=TRUE)

redcap <- read.csv(file='../data/redcap/redcap_scored.csv')

redcap_amedt <- amedt %>%
  select(c("SURVEY_CODE", "EDT.ability")) %>%
  merge(redcap, by.y="SURVEY_CODE", by.x="SURVEY_CODE", all.y=TRUE)

study1 <- read.csv(file='../data/Study 1 Scores/study1_granularityscores.csv')
study2 <- read.csv(file='../data/Study 1 Scores/study2_granularityscores.csv')

study1$study <- "study1"
study2$study <- "study2"
```

```{r}
common_cols <- intersect(names(qualtrics_amedt), names(redcap_amedt))

master_survey <- rbind(qualtrics_amedt[common_cols],redcap_amedt[common_cols])

master <- rbind(study1,study2) %>%
  merge(master_survey, by.x="ID",by.y="SURVEY_CODE", all.x = TRUE)


master_qual <- rbind(study1,study2) %>%
  merge(qualtrics_amedt, by.x="ID",by.y="SURVEY_CODE", all.x = TRUE)

master_red <- rbind(study1,study2) %>%
  merge(redcap_amedt, by.x="ID",by.y="SURVEY_CODE", all.x = TRUE)
```

#corr matrix
```{r}
master %>% 
  rename(
   pos_emo_granularity_music = posmusicICC,
    neg_emo_granularity_music = negmusicICC,
   pos_emo_granularity_pics =  pospicICC,
    neg_emo_granularity_pic = negpicICC,
   combined_emo_granularity_music = allmusicICC,
   combined_emo_granularity_pic = allpicICC
    )


# Select only the numeric columns for the correlation matrix
matrix_columns <- master[c(3:9,11:24,26:34)]
matrix_columns <- matrix_columns[, !(names(matrix_columns) %in% "study")]

correlation_matrix <- cor(matrix_columns, use = "complete.obs")

# Calculate the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix <- cor(matrix_columns, use = "complete.obs")

# Function to compute significance levels
cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  diag(p.mat) <- 0
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      tmp <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], conf.level = conf.level)
      p.mat[i, j] <- p.mat[j, i] <- tmp$p.value
    }
  }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  p.mat
}

# Compute p-values
p_values <- cor.mtest(matrix_columns)

# Specify the folder where you want to save the file
output_folder <- "../results/qualtrics/"

# Combine the folder path with the file name
output_file <- file.path(output_folder, "full_surveys_corrmatrix.png")

# Open a PNG device with the specified file path
png(output_file, width = 800, height = 800)

# Generate the corrplot
corrplot(correlation_matrix, method = "circle", type = "upper", 
         p.mat = p_values, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "blank",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, addCoef.col = NULL,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200))

title(main = "", col.main = "black", font.main = 4)

# Close the PNG device
dev.off()
```
#scatterplots
```{r}
ggplot(data=master_red, aes(x=negmusicICC,y=scaared_total))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.7)+
  stat_smooth(method="lm") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Negative Emotional Granularity - Music") +
  ylab("BDI Score")

#AMEDT SCATTERPLOT 8/5/26

library(ggplot2)

amedt_var <- "EDT.ability"
icc_vars <- c("negmusicICC", "posmusicICC", "allmusicICC")

setdiff(c(amedt_var, icc_vars), names(master_red))
sapply(master_red[, c(amedt_var, icc_vars)], class)

dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

results <- data.frame(
  icc = character(),
  survey = character(),
  r = numeric(),
  r_squared = numeric(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  n = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (icc in icc_vars) {
  
  complete_data <- master_red[!is.na(master_red[[icc]]) & !is.na(master_red[[amedt_var]]), ]
  n_obs <- nrow(complete_data)
  
  r <- cor.test(complete_data[[icc]], complete_data[[amedt_var]])
  r_val <- round(as.numeric(r$estimate), 3)
  r_squared <- round(as.numeric(r$estimate)^2, 3)
  p_val <- r$p.value
  
  cat("\n---", icc, "vs", amedt_var, "---\n")
  cat("r =", r_val, "\n")
  cat("R\u00b2 =", r_squared, "\n")
  cat("p =", round(p_val, 4), "\n")
  cat("n =", n_obs, "\n")
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    icc = icc,
    survey = amedt_var,
    r = r_val,
    r_squared = r_squared,
    p_value = round(p_val, 4),
    n = n_obs
  ))
  
  p_label <- if (p_val < 0.001) "< .001" else paste0("= ", round(p_val, 3))
  
  p <- ggplot(complete_data, aes(x = .data[[icc]], y = .data[[amedt_var]])) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue", fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(
      x = icc,
      y = amedt_var,
      title = paste(icc, "vs", amedt_var),
      subtitle = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r_squared, "  |  p ", p_label, "  |  n = ", n_obs)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  
  ggsave(file.path("plots", paste0("plot_", icc, "_", amedt_var, ".png")), 
         plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  
  print(p)
}

cat("\n=== Summary Table ===\n")
results <- results[order(-abs(results$r)), ]
rownames(results) <- NULL
print(results)

```
